lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible high-luminance circular spots are arranged in a regular grid of approximately 6 vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with each column containing 4 to 5 visible nodes within the lateral field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run between the columns of spots, forming a coordinate-like structure where spots are centrally positioned between these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, manifesting as linear features with a high-intensity dorsal border and a low-intensity ventral shadow, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, with approximately 6-8 spots visible in a semi-ordered vertical arrangement on the leading half of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating a focal tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered ventrally beneath the pectoral fin and along the lower flank.
